notes.F35: Bicycle table gives Kumla5 ahead/Haga0.2 left in kilometres, not metres.
notes.F37: Bicycle above Centrum3 is distance board for that user group.
notes.F38: Yellow bicycle identifies designated cycle route; colour can vary rather than mandating cyclepath blue circle.
notes.G1: Looped horn indicates postal agent with parcels/letters/stamps, not priority.
notes.G2: Handset and SOS identify help telephone.
notes.G3: RadioFM4 and98.7 are example recurring traffic broadcast details, not a driving instruction.
notes.G4: Red cross identifies hospital with emergency department, narrower than any medical facility.
notes.G5: Factory silhouette identifies industrial destination without vehicle restriction.
notes.G6: Front train and clock identify station, distinct from railway crossing warning.
notes.G7: Front bus identifies multi-route bus station, not a circular bus-only lane.
notes.G8: Aircraft nose points left and indicates scheduled-service airport.
notes.G10: Shopping trolley identifies commercial area, not a single named shop.
notes.G11: Ship with masts/waves indicates ferry terminal or destination reached by ferry.
notes.G12: Open-sided boat with people identifies passenger ferry, without promising carriage of a car.
notes.H1: Lowercase i identifies information point; information type may be separately stated.
notes.H2: Black post/tool-like symbol is exact repair-workshop illustration; neutral words avoid semantic code disclosure.
notes.H3: Pump identifies fuel facility; approach restrictions remain.
notes.H4: Exact CNG pump variant is compressed natural gas; LPG/LNG/H2 cannot be silently interchanged.
notes.H5: Cup and saucer identify drinks/simple meals rather than full restaurant.
notes.H6: Crossed spoon/fork identify restaurant without opening-hours guarantee.
notes.H8: House and fir tree identify hostel, distinct from hotel bed and cottage village.
notes.H9: Three houses identify larger cottage establishment rather than H10 few cottages.
